name: @zdreamer/forge-ts-react-frontend
description: Opinionated presets and structural enforcement for Forge React frontends

scripts.build: tsc --ignoreConfig src/structure.ts --target ES2023 --module NodeNext --moduleResolution NodeNext --declaration --types node --strict --exactOptionalPropertyTypes --noUncheckedIndexedAccess --skipLibCheck --outDir dist
scripts.lint: biome check --config-path=presets/biome-preset.json package.json presets src tests
scripts.check: node --run build && biome check --config-path=presets/biome-preset.json package.json presets src tests && node --test
